ayahOccurrences.text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مَّنضُودٍ is in the derivative form: مَنْضُودٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ض/د   n–ḍ–d pile of things, bunches of fruit growing in rows over 1 another, layers of clouds, stack of stones; the family elders.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 3 times in the Qur’an:
نَضِيدٌ naḍıd 1 time and مَنْضُودٌ manḍūd 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مَنْضُودٌ manḍūd [pass. part.]

1 arranged in rows, clustered, piled up

(56:29) وَطَلْحٍ مَنْضُودٍ and clustered acacia

2 sequenced, one after the other

(11:82) وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ مَنْضُودٍ and we rained upon it stones of baked clay, layer after layer.

entries.label: نَضِيدٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَضِيدٌ naḍıd [pass. part.] arranged in rows, stacked up on top of each other

(50:10) وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ and palm trees, lofty and laden with fruit.
